label: Media Slider
purpose: Slideshow of product images or videos with optional captions
_notes:
The real schema repeats this same id pattern up to 10 times (image_1..image_10/image_desc_1..image_desc_10, and video_1..video_10/video_thumb_1..video_thumb_10/video_desc_1..video_desc_10) — only the first few slots are listed here since most products need a handful of slides, not ten; additional numbered slots may be used the same way if more are genuinely needed. display_images/display_videos gate whether their respective slides render at all. image_desc_N/video_desc_N are richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags. Leave every image/video field as an empty string — images and videos are filled in separately. All slider mechanics (autoplay, arrows, dots, spacing, corner radius, video player controls) are pure layout and intentionally excluded.
